source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit (other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**) Falls Back while in **Engagement Range** of any of your units with this ability, every model in it has to take a **[Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)**. If that unit is **Battle‑shocked** as well, 1 is subtracted from each of those tests.

trigger.enemyWithinEngagementRangeOf: one or more friendly units with this ability

effect.desperateEscapeTests: every model in the enemy unit
